If you frequently experience pain or discomfort in your stomach following a meal, it’s not to be taken lightly. At Silver Touch Hospitals, we encounter many patients who have been enduring post-meal pain for months or even weeks, waiting for it to subside on its own.

The fact is, frequent stomach pain can be indicative of many digestive conditions requiring prompt medical care. That’s why it is essential to visit the best gastroenterology hospital in Ahmedabad.

Understanding the Possible Causes

Postprandial abdominal pain isn’t necessarily associated with anything life-threatening, but ongoing distress may be a sign of issues like gastritis, acid reflux disease, gallstones, irritable bowel syndrome, or food intolerance. At other times, it’s simply a matter of overeating or eating too fast, but in some instances, inflammation within the stomach lining or gallbladder issues may be the culprit.

Our gastro experts at Silver Touch Hospitals start by understanding your lifestyle, dietary patterns, and symptoms in detail by taking a thorough medical history. This enables us to limit the possibilities before recommending tests.

How Is Diagnosis Done?

Accurate diagnosis is key to effective treatment. At Silver Touch Hospitals, our first step is usually a thorough clinical evaluation. This may be followed by a series of diagnostic tests that are available in-house, including blood investigations, ultrasound scans, X ray and Endoscopy as per need.

Blood investigations assist in the detection of infection, inflammation, or liver abnormalities, while ultrasonography is important for the recognition of gallstones, fatty liver, or other structural abnormalities in the abdomen. In some patients, an ECG or exercise test may also be advised if the pattern of pain arouses suspicion of cardiac rather than gastric aetiology.

By using these diagnostic instruments in conjunction with clinical experience, our gastro expert can identify the underlying cause effectively and initiate treatment at an early stage.

Treatment and Relief

Treatment could be by medicine, diet change, or minor surgery if it is required. For instance, gastritis or acid reflux could be treated with medication and lifestyle modification, while gallstones could need to be treated by surgery.

We advise each patient on diet management (small, frequent meals, decreased oily or spicy food), and adequate hydration usually makes a huge difference.

At Silver Touch Hospitals, we are committed to offering extensive digestive care that not just fixes the condition but also prevents recurrence. Our skilled physicians and radiology team collaborate to provide proper diagnosis and efficient treatment plans.

When to Seek Help?
